name: Run and drive - a headless, off-road proof
what: Every box (PMU box, bin box, bay junction) and every leg (L1-L4) built once to the full plan - every housing fitted, unused cavities sealed, later conductors run, capped and labelled, the later modules' dash-post plugs blanked, the PMU's later outputs off. The factory harness comes out whole - nothing spliced, nothing of it left. Only what runs and drives the car is connected: the backbone, the PMU, the EMU Black with the AEM wideband, the engine leg, the fuel pump, the fan, the start. No cluster: the laptop is the dash. Not driven on the road (D-647)
money: about $3,100-3,900 plus the EMU Black (01-engine EC01)
after: The engine's W1, at the same time

name: Road: the road circuits and the Display Unit
what: The lights, brakes, turns, reverse, wipers and washer, pop-ups, horn and illumination connected on the legs W1 laid; the Display Unit as the cluster (the 12.3 in display, the BT817 board, the ICU carrier and its firmware, the road-speed sensor, the log link); the full function check and the road shakedowns. The car goes on the road here (D-647)
after: W1 proven; the DU proven on the bench (stage F)

name: The Control Unit
what: The CU (DCU carrier), its panel and face, the CUR (hazard, winks, hatch keys, mirror control), the comfort enable
after: W1; the CU proven on the bench

name: The luxury wiring
what: The doors, the HVAC servos and blower, the hatch and fuel-door releases, the radar runs, the audio and the amplifier dock; the devices are 04-luxury's
money: about $200-400 of electrical's own wire and plugs
after: W3 for the comfort enable; 04-luxury's picks
